description: Rede Geodésica is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Base Geodésica do Distrito Federal SICAD, em conformidade com Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística – IBGE, de 25 de fevereiro de 2005, o Sistema Geodésico Brasileiro – SGB é constituído pelo Sistema SIRGAS – 2000. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Cartografia e Topografia, Cartografia, Topografia, Rede Geodésica, Base Geodésica do Distrito Federal SICAD. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
